mapper.sql: id, user_id, kind, item_type, item_id, target_user_id, expires_at, created_at, revoked_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feed_feedback (id, user_id, kind, item_type, item_id, target_user_id, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{kind}, #{itemType}, #{itemId}, #{targetUserId}, #{expiresAt}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE feed_feedback SET revoked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM feed_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (kind = 'HIDE_POST' OR expires_at > NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feed_feedback WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM feed_feedback WHERE (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at < #{cutoff}) OR (kind = 'HIDE_AUTHOR' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at < #{cutoff}) LIMIT #{limit})
